metadata.title: PsModuleManagement
metadata.description:
Powershell Module Management with install, repair, uninstall, test connectivity, monitoring, clean-up
    Features: 
        Version management of Azure, Microsoft.Graph, ExchangeOnlineManagement and more PS modules 
        Installing latest version of modules, if not found 
        Automatic repair of PS module, if connectivity fails 
        Automatic update to latest version of module from PSGallery 
        Testing connectivity and doing rollback if it fails 
        Send status emails of PS module management progress (success and/or issues) 
        Automatic clean-up old versions

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'SendMailNotificationsPsModuleManagement' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$SMTP_Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
